standard.name: Title screen
standard.pass: The game reports a title scene (ArcadeSDK.state({scene:'title'})) or the first frame is not blank.

standard.name: How to play
standard.pass: At least 2 steps in meta, and the arcade's Help button opens them inside the game.

standard.name: Controls
standard.pass: Keyboard and touch controls written in meta.

standard.name: Pause
standard.pass: On-screen pause button; the arcade's Pause freezes the canvas, the clock and audio; P or Esc pauses where free; a hidden tab pauses.

standard.name: Resume
standard.pass: After a 2 s pause the game clock has not jumped and the game moves again.

standard.name: Restart
standard.pass: The game restarts the run itself (ArcadeSDK onRestart), without reloading the page.

standard.name: Exit to title
standard.pass: The game returns to its title itself (ArcadeSDK onExit).

standard.name: Sound
standard.pass: The arcade's Mute silences every audio context and media element, and the choice is remembered.

standard.name: Settings
standard.pass: Sound always; 3D tiers also list a graphics-quality setting in meta.settings.

standard.name: Tips
standard.pass: At least 3 tips in meta, shown on the pause menu.

standard.name: Results screen
standard.pass: The game reports scene 'over' with a score or outcome during the scripted session, or meta.features.results says where it is (REVIEW).

standard.name: Saving
standard.pass: A key named in meta.saves (the best score or progress, not a first-run flag or setting) is in localStorage or IndexedDB after the session.

standard.name: Phone
standard.pass: At 390x844 with touch: no sideways scroll, DOM text at least 12 px, DOM tap targets at least 40 px.

standard.name: Stability
standard.pass: 0 page errors, 0 console errors and 0 failed requests from the game.

standard.name: Loading
standard.pass: Something visible within 1 s of the game frame loading, and the SDK ready within 20 s.

standard.name: Accessibility
standard.pass: The game respects prefers-reduced-motion.

standard.name: Arcade SDK
standard.pass: The SDK loads and says ready; the game calls ArcadeSDK.init to declare what it supports.

standard.name: Catalogue
standard.pass: Category, genre, 2+ tags, blurb, howto, tips, controls, a 480x300 tile and a 960x600 tile.

standard.name: Tutorial
standard.pass: The game can replay its tutorial (ArcadeSDK onTutorial).

standard.name: Hints
standard.pass: Required for puzzle and learning games: the arcade's hint request returns a hint.

standard.name: Difficulty
standard.pass: meta.difficulty says how difficulty works (modes, adaptive curve or age bands).

standard.name: Cheat codes
standard.pass: Eligible games list 3+ codes in meta and the game accepts each one through the SDK.

standard.name: Genre module
standard.pass: Every feature of the genre module is described in meta.features (REVIEW until a person confirms it).

standard.name: Tricks
standard.pass: Board-sports games: 6+ named tricks with inputs, shown in the pause menu's Trick list.

standard.name: Graphics tier
standard.pass: 3D tiers render in 3D (WebGL context plus a 3D engine); 2D-HD canvases are crisp at the device pixel ratio.

standard.name: Progression
standard.pass: Progress that persists (meta.saves names a key that is written) and real goals to come back for: levels, worlds, unlocks, stars or upgrades. The game tells the arcade profile where the player is with ArcadeSDK.state({scene, score, level, stars}). Always REVIEW for now: the harness lists what it saw and a person (or the progression checker) confirms the goals are real.

U01.note: Something is on screen; a person should confirm it is a title with a clear Play button.

U02.note: The arcade Help button opened 5 steps inside the game.

U04.note: Pause froze picture, clock and audio, menu showed a tip; P and Esc pause.

U05.note: Resumed where it stopped: no time jump (0 ms), and the picture moves again.

U06.note: Restart falls back to reloading the game (add ArcadeSDK onRestart).

U07.note: Exit to title falls back to reloading the game (add ArcadeSDK onExit).

U08.note: Mute works, but the game made no sound in the scripted session.

U10.note: 5 tips; the pause menu shows one.

U11.note: No results scene reported (ArcadeSDK.state({scene:"over"})) and none described in meta.

U13.note: 5 text run(s) under 12 px, e.g. 1 (11.5px); 10 (11.5px); 100 (11.5px); 4 tap target(s) under 40 px, e.g. 1 25x23; 10 31x23; 100 38x23

U14.note: No errors and no failed requests.

U15.note: First picture within 1 s; frame loaded in 0.1 s, SDK ready 0.0 s after Play.

U16.note: Ignores the reduced-motion setting (screen shake and flashes stay on).

U17.note: Ready, and the game declares what it supports.

H01.note: The game does not offer a tutorial replay (ArcadeSDK onTutorial).

H02.note: Recommended, not required, for Idle / tycoon games.

H03.note: No modes: one long curve. Each building costs 15% more than the last of its kind, upgrades multiply what they make, and Legacy resets the run for permanent Golden Dough — the genre-standard prestige loop.

G01.note: Idle / tycoon: all 4 features described; a person should confirm them.

T01.note: Only board-sports games need a trick list.

X01.note: Crisp: canvas 780px wide for 390 CSS px at DPR 3.

P01.note: Saw: saves cc_save_v1, cc_rec (written); reports scene; no goals described in meta.progression. REVIEW until the goals (levels, worlds, unlocks, stars, upgrades) are confirmed real.
